connectorUiConfig.title: Darktrace Platform Portal Connector
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The Darktrace Platform Portal connector pushes normalized Secure AI agent risk events into the Microsoft-managed `PartnerRiskEvents` shared table in Microsoft Sentinel using the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API. Send records with `EventVendor` set to `Darktrace`.

graphQueries.metricName: Total unified agent risk events received
graphQueries.legend: Darktrace Secure AI unified agent risk

sampleQueries.query:
PartnerRiskEvents
| where EventVendor == "Darktrace"
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: PartnerRiskEvents
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
PartnerRiskEvents
| where EventVendor == "Darktrace"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value:
PartnerRiskEvents
| where EventVendor == "Darktrace"
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(7d)

instructionSteps.title: 1. Create ARM Resources and Provide the Required Permissions
instructionSteps.description: Enable the Microsoft Sentinel Log Ingestion configuration in Darktrace to push normalized Secure AI agent risk events through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API into PartnerRiskEvents.

parameters.content:
#### Automated Configuration and Secure Data Ingestion with Entra Application
Clicking **Deploy** creates a Data Collection Endpoint (DCE) and a Data Collection Rule (DCR) targeting the Microsoft-managed `PartnerRiskEvents` shared table. It then creates a Microsoft Entra application, grants it access to the DCR, and configures a client secret for secure ingestion.

The `PartnerRiskEvents` table must be available in the target workspace. This connector does not create a custom table or define the shared table's schema. Existing data in custom tables is not migrated or deleted.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Push your logs into the workspace
instructionSteps.description: Use the following parameters to configure Darktrace to send normalized JSON records with EventVendor set to Darktrace. Keep the Custom-UnifiedAgentRisk_CL input stream and the ResourceId, ResourceType, and ResourceName fields in your payload. The DCR renames these fields to TargetResourceId, TargetResourceType, and TargetResourceName in PartnerRiskEvents.
